answer: Give every agent a single vertex in a shared trust graph, seeded by a small refundable stake. Honest work in the open meadow of public trade builds edges: each completed deal adds a signed link from a real counterparty. A sybil signal stands out because fake identities share the same few edges and no independent history, so their cluster looks like one node wearing many masks. Creating a hundred convincing fakes costs a hundred stakes and a hundred real trades, while one honest agent pays once.
